<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
there is acc issue in qwen3.5 shared expert dual stream, due to apply same shared expert stream for mtp and target model, which could lead to  data corruption.
## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
following deepseek model, use different stream for mtp and target model when enable dual stream.
## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->
Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B ceval acc
this pr:
92.7
official:
93.0

export ASCEND_USE_FIA=1
export SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=128
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2400
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_ROUND=20
export DEEPEP_NORMAL_LONG_SEQ_PER_ROUND_TOKENS=4096

export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV
export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo

export SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1
export SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1
export SGLANG_NPU_USE_MULTI_STREAM=1
export DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1

sglang serve \
--model-path  Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-w4a8-mtp \
--attention-backend ascend \
--device npu \
--tp-size 8 \
--chunked-prefill-size 58880 \
--max-prefill-tokens 65536 --max-mamba-cache-size 100 \
--mamba-scheduler-strategy extra_buffer \
--trust-remote-code \
--host 127.0.0.1 --max-running-requests 32 \
--mem-fraction-static 0.65 \
--port 31125 \
--quantization modelslim \
--enable-multimodal --moe-a2a-backend deepep --deepep-mode auto \
--mm-attention-backend ascend_attn  \
--dtype bfloat16 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 \
--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant
